# Perl Testing

Curated by Skill Harbor: comprehensive Perl testing patterns that bring modern discipline to a language whose test tooling predates most frameworks. It covers the full stack: Test2::V0 and Test::More assertions, the prove runner for executing suites, mocking strategies, coverage measurement with Devel::Cover, and the red/green/refactor TDD cycle applied to Perl modules. Includes migration guidance from Test::More to Test2::V0, suite design for modules and applications, debugging failing tests, and worked examples (a Calculator module built test-first, subtests with done_testing). Use it when writing new Perl code, reviewing coverage, setting up test infrastructure, or modernizing a legacy suite. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: assumes a working Perl toolchain (prove, cpanm); coverage numbers guide, they do not guarantee correctness; legacy Perl may need dependency updates before modern Test2 features work. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
